enso.advisory_text: 8 August 2026 : A weak to moderate El Niño is present in the tropical Pacific. Climate models suggest that El Niño will likely intensify over the next few seasons and persist until the first half of 2027 (~97%). A strong El Niño is likely to emerge by the July-Aug-Sep season (~57%), and a very strong El Niño is favored during the Oct-Nov-Dec and Nov-Dec-Jan seasons (~81%).    (updated: 22 July 2026) Trunkline No.: (02)8284-0800  local 4920 and 4921

Cagayan, Aurora, Batangas, some parts of Palawan, Albay, Catanduanes, East Panay, Eastern Samar, Negros Oriental, and Zamboanga del Sur

A weak to moderate El Niño is currently present in the tropical Pacific. Climate models indicate that it is likely to intensify and persist through the first half of 2027 (97% probability). There is a 57% probability of El Niño strengthening to a strong event during the July–August–September (JAS) 2026 season, while a very strong El Niño is favored during the October–November–December (OND) 2026 and November–December–January (NDJ) 2026–2027 seasons, with an estimated 81% probability.
(Batanes and Babuyan Islands {Babuyan Is., Calayan Is.})
